$comment: G90 (D72): proposed additions to docs/specification/contracts/api/commands.schema.json for the learner view and memory review (MEM-09, MEM-14, LRN-36, LRN-37, UXS-28, PRV-10). Merge `x-endpoints` into the file's x-endpoints list and `$defs` into its $defs. Also proposed: a TABLE API-32a row 409 `review_changed`, and an API-07 prefix row `rvw_` (memory review item, minted by the core). Every command answers with the profile's KnowsView as it is after the command, so the page never shows a stale state. `x-authorization: profile_or_adult` means: the X-Profile-Token of {profile_id} (the student, actor_role student), or a valid X-Adult-Token for any profile on this device, including a locked one (the PIN-protected view of LRN-36 and UXS-28; actor_role adult). With both, the actor is the adult. Any other profile id answers 404 not_found (API-04). These are not TCH-13a adult controls: a student reaches every one of them with the profile token alone.

x-endpoints.description: The "What your tutor knows" view (LRN-36, MEM-14, UXS-28, PRV-10): the learner model as states, bands and labels (never probabilities), active notes (each marked when it fails the render check, MEM-27), open review items pinned to the versions shown (MEM-09), preferences, whether saving notes is on (MEM-06) and the sharing flags the page's sentence follows.

Accept or reject one review item (MEM-09) for exactly the versions shown: pending_version and target_version must equal the item's current ones, else 409 review_changed with details.review holding the item as it is now (shown again). An item that no longer exists answers 404. Accepting a replacement makes the pending note active and deletes the note it replaces; rejecting deletes the pending note; accepting a drop deletes the note; rejecting a drop keeps it. Every deletion erases the note's text (LRN-37) and open sessions drop it (MEM-11).

"This isn't right" on a note (UXS-28, LRN-37): one batch of a correction event (target note, action dispute) and the note's deletion with erasure of its text, as DELETE /v1/memory/{note_id} does. A pending note is answered through its review item instead (404 here).

"This isn't right" on a misconception (LRN-37): a correction event that sets it disputed, so it leaves the page's watch list and the prompt until misconception_dispute_reactivate new matches; undispute withdraws the dispute. Only a misconception the profile has (active or resolving to dispute, disputed to undispute); any other id is 404.

Edit how the student likes to learn (LRN-37, PRV-10): a correction event (target preference) that overrides the inferred value, or with value null clears the override. A value the preference cannot take is 422; an unknown key is 404.

KnowsView.description: GET /v1/profiles/{profile_id}/knows and every memory review or correction command (LRN-36, MEM-14, UXS-28). Plain codes, never probabilities: the client turns states, bands, statuses and preference values into localised words.

viewer.description: Who the request acts as: the student with their profile token, or the device adult with X-Adult-Token.

kcs.description: Every KC with evidence, in id order. band secure is "Going well", learning is "Working on".

misconceptions.description: "Mistakes we're watching": active and resolving misconceptions, active first.

name.description: The pack's student-facing name (the id when no installed pack names it).

memory_saving.description: The student's "Save notes about me" preference (MEM-06). Off stops new notes; the notes here stay readable.

anyOf.description: Inputs of the page's sharing sentence (LRN-36): each flag is true only while that consent is effective (ConsentState.effective).

text.description: The stored text, to be rendered as text, never as markup (MEM-27).

source.description: Who the note came from: the Reflector, the student's own request (MEM-11), or a note the student or the adult has corrected (MEM-09: theirs).

flagged.description: Fails the render check (MEM-27): never in a prompt, shown so it can be deleted.

created_ts.description: ms since Unix epoch, server clock

updated_ts.description: ms since Unix epoch: the last write of its text (G95)

ReviewItem.description: A change the Reflector may not make on its own (MEM-09). replace: pending would supersede target (a contradiction, or an update of a note the student owns); target is null when the note it contradicted is gone. drop: a proposal to remove target, a note the student owns; pending is null.

ReviewResolution.description: POST /v1/profiles/{profile_id}/memory/reviews/{review_id} (MEM-09): the answer and the two versions it was given for, copied from the ReviewItem shown.

PreferenceCorrection.description: PATCH /v1/profiles/{profile_id}/preferences/{key} (LRN-37): the student's value, or null to clear the override and return to the inferred one.

preference_value.description: start_style: worked_example | hint; representation: diagram | simpler_numbers | analogy | worked_example; pace: short | normal; unprompted_help and self_explanation_prompts: boolean. A value outside its key's set is 422.

memory_version.description: The id of the newest event touching a note or proposal (opaque to the client): the version a review answer is pinned to (MEM-09).
